pages.text: A current through a metal salt lays the metal down on the cathode: $(thing)m = MIt/(nF)$() (Faraday). Nitric acid takes the nickel out of meteoric iron as $(fluid)Nickel Sulfate Solution$(); the $(item)Electroplating Bath$() puts it back on iron. Set the current and time for a coat 20 to 50 µm thick; above 8 A/dm² it burns. $(item)Nickel-Plated Iron$() makes $(item)Corrosion-Proof Casings$().
